description: Change the less-than operator to less-than-or-equal, causing zero duration to incorrectly throw an exception.
Change the less-than operator to not-equal, which breaks positive values and changes the condition boundary.
Change the validation check to trigger only when duration is strictly less than -1, allowing -1 to pass without exception.
Remove the validation call from the constructor, allowing negative durations to be silently accepted.
Negate the validation condition so that only negative numbers pass and positive/zero numbers throw an exception.
